disorder-name.detail: First-episode schizophrenia spectrum psychosis (schizophrenia, schizophreniform disorder, schizoaffective disorder).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "patients with a first-episode schizophrenia spectrum diagnosis (SCZ) were consecutively recruited"; "schizophrenia ( n = 57, 72% of the final, quality-checked longitudinal sample),  schizophreniform  disorders  ( n = 18, 23%), and schizoaffective ( n = 4, 5%)."
